sessions.title: Buttonwood Library Train Route
sessions.clubUse: Adult-led 40-minute story club session for a library program, co-op table, classroom center, or tutoring group using printed pages only.
sessions.kidDirection: Choose one train stop, add three quiet library details, and write a short route note for the next reader.
sessions.facilitatorNote: Keep the session fictional and materials on the table; use table symbols if writers choose to share aloud.
sessions.takeHomeLine: Take this page home and add one more Buttonwood Library train stop with an adult.
materials: Small paper strip for a route marker

pageSections.heading: Reading Car
lines: Inside the reading car, the seat looks like ____________________________.

pageSections.heading: Route Note
lines: The note for the next reader says ____________________________.

sessions.title: Pocket Park Notice Circle
sessions.clubUse: Printable circle-time writing page for an adult-led library club, classroom station, co-op meetup, or tutoring warmup.
sessions.kidDirection: Invent three park notices, choose the clearest one, and write what the pocket park helper does next.
sessions.facilitatorNote: Invite children to suggest ordinary objects or colors; skip any personal details from real families or real places.
sessions.takeHomeLine: Take this notice page home and finish the Pocket Park message board later.

pageSections.heading: Notice Ideas
lines: The first tiny notice asks for ____________________________.
The second tiny notice points to ____________________________.
The third tiny notice reminds everyone about ____________________________.

sessions.title: Penny Path Compass Table
sessions.clubUse: Adult-led printable direction-writing session for a library story club, co-op writing table, classroom group, or tutoring lesson.
sessions.kidDirection: Pick a compass clue, draw a penny path, and write three clear directions for a careful shop helper.
sessions.facilitatorNote: Pair children for one quiet idea share, then return pages to individual writing so every child keeps their own work.
sessions.takeHomeLine: Take this compass page home and add a new Penny Path shop direction.

pageSections.heading: Path Map
lines: The final path mark looks like ____________________________.

sessions.title: Acorn Avenue Errand Desk
sessions.clubUse: Printable adult-led story club session for a library program, tutoring table, co-op meeting, or classroom writing block.
sessions.kidDirection: Sort three friendly errand slips, choose a helpful order, and write the desk note that explains the route.
sessions.facilitatorNote: Model one invented errand on a shared scrap, then steer every label toward invented places and fictional details.
sessions.takeHomeLine: Take this errand page home and finish one more Acorn Avenue desk note.

pageSections.heading: Errand Slips
lines: The second leaf slip belongs at ____________________________.
The third leaf slip is marked with ____________________________.

pageSections.heading: Desk Sort
lines: The helper chooses the order because ____________________________.

sessions.title: Seed Library Map Room
sessions.clubUse: Adult-led 45-minute printable story club session for older elementary library groups, co-ops, classrooms, or tutoring groups.
sessions.groupMode: Small group planning with individual drafts
sessions.kidDirection: Choose a seed drawer, add observation clues to a garden map, and write a return note for the next gardener.
sessions.facilitatorNote: Keep the seed library fictional and observation-based; use invented gardens and fictional notes only.
sessions.takeHomeLine: Take this map page home and add one more Seed Library observation note.

pageSections.heading: Return Note
lines: The return note for the next gardener says ____________________________.
